description: Return the progress or result of an analysis started with initiate_analysis, by its analysis_id. Each call returns the current state once and does not wait. While status is in_progress, or narrative.status is pending or running, check again only when the person asks, and no sooner than retry_after_seconds. A failed status is an answer; relay error_message. A complete result is the saved report: the composite score and rating word, the evidence word (Full, Core or Low), each domain's score, grade word and contribution (cornerstone, major, supporting or contextual), its key_drivers (up to three, each with its evidence), lens and domain_coverage, and its written summaries (domain conclusions, synthesis, key strengths and challenges) at either depth once narrative.status is ready. Until then relay message: pending or running means they are still being written, and you may briefly summarize the scores and evidence supplied but never write a summary, cause or reason the result does not contain; failed means they could not be completed, and the scores and evidence stand. It omits the web reader's factor cards, charts and per-anchor Explain views. Offer report_url as Open saved report to inspect factor values, peer context and ranked contributors where supplied; sign in to the owning StockLens account. It can open before the written summaries finish, and opening it does not start another run. Say how much a domain counts only with its contribution word, never as a number or share. It does not accept a ticker and does not rank companies.
name: fetch_analysis_result

base_digest.description: Identifies the saved scores and evidence of a complete result. It stays the same when the written summaries arrive.

deterministic_ready_at.description: When the scores and evidence were saved, ahead of the written summaries (ISO 8601). Absent when the report was saved together with its summaries.

message.description: A sentence to relay as given, present when the written summaries of a complete result are not ready: they are still being written, or could not be completed.

narrative.description: The state of the written summaries (the domain conclusions, the synthesis, and the key strengths and challenges) of a complete result.

error_code.description: Why the written summaries failed, as a diagnostic code.

ready_at.description: When the written summaries became ready (ISO 8601).

revision.description: Rises with every change of the summaries' state; a higher revision is the newer answer.

status.description: pending or running: still being written, and not in this result. ready: in this result. failed: could not be completed; the scores and evidence are unaffected.

report_url.description: Open this saved report for factor values, peer context and ranked contributors through Explain where supplied. Sign in to the owning StockLens account. Reading it does not start another analysis. Present with every complete result, which has passed ownership checks; the report can open before its written summaries finish.

sentiment_sources_note.description: The Sentiment evidence this reading did not use and why, as one sentence to relay as given, for example: Evidence not read in this analysis: earnings calls (none found recently).

title: Fetch Analysis Result
